text: 我们医院扫卫生间的阿姨就是40多岁的大龄剩女，大家嘘嘘时，她就在一旁拖地。
en: Our hospital's toilet-cleaning lady is a woman in her forties who is still unmarried, and when people go for a wee she mops the floor right beside them.

text: 粗略看一下各位答主的答案，真的惊掉下巴。
en: Skimming through the answers from the various respondents, I was genuinely gobsmacked.

text: 题主或者是绝大多数男人把40岁的男人想象成头发浓密，身材保持很好，又有钱的中年男人了吧？
en: The OP, or perhaps the vast majority of men, picture a 40-year-old man as a middle-aged man with a thick head of hair, a well-maintained figure, and money, don't they?

text: 可是事实上，地中海，堪比怀孕五个月甚至七个月的大肚子，又穷，这种比比皆是。
en: But in reality, the bald-on-top type, with a belly rivalling a five-month, even seven-month pregnancy, and broke to boot—such men are ten a penny.

text: 球球了，拜托了，醒一醒，40岁的单身男女根本相互看不上，单到这个年龄的优质男女都喜欢年轻人，有活力，有激情，有恋爱的味道。
en: I'm begging you, please, wake up. Single men and women at 40 simply don't fancy each other; the high-quality single men and women who've remained unmarried to this age all like young people—full of energy, passion, the flavour of romance.

text: 劣质的就甭提了，都往上找，55以上男女能嫁娶就不错了。
en: As for the low-quality ones, let's not even mention them; they all look upward in age, and for men and women over 55, just managing to marry at all is good enough.

text: 看完答案，午饭差点没吐出来。
en: After reading the answers, I nearly threw up my lunch.

text: 女网友说：今天脚崴了，口腔溃疡，姨妈来了，手腕脱臼了，腰闪了，拉肚子，痔疮还犯了.
en: A female netizen said: today I twisted my ankle, got a mouth ulcer, got my period, dislocated my wrist, threw my back out, have diarrhoea, and my haemorrhoids flared up again.

text: 我该怎么办？
en: What should I do?

text: 要是我没干过律师我就真的信了
en: If I hadn't worked as a lawyer, I would have truly believed it.

text: 我认识的四十岁左右、履历优秀的男性多了去了，有年入百万以上的精英、有年营业额上亿公司的老板、有专业性极强的科技从业者，个个拿出来都能在知乎上算优质男。
en: I know plenty of men around forty with excellent CVs—elites earning over a million a year, bosses of companies with annual turnovers in the hundreds of millions, highly specialised tech professionals. Any one of them, taken on his own, would count as a high-quality man on Zhihu.

text: 但也没有普遍性娶年轻姑娘。
en: But there's no general pattern of them marrying young girls either.

text: 四十多+不喜欢老女人只喜欢小姑娘，基本都这样，半点不稀奇。
en: A man in his forties who doesn't like older women and only likes young girls—that's basically the norm, and not the least bit surprising.

text: 问题是再优秀的男的也仅仅是男的，不是皇帝，只能自由恋爱不能选妃，光自己看上了没用，得二十岁小姑娘能同意，另外搞定只比自己大几岁的老丈人+丈母娘，才能抱得美人归。
en: The problem is, no matter how outstanding the man is, he's still just a man, not an emperor; he can only pursue free love, not select concubines. It's useless if only he's keen—the twenty-year-old girl has to agree, and on top of that you have to win over the father-in-law and mother-in-law who are only a few years older than him, before you can win the beauty's hand.

text: 所以他们共同特点不仅仅是年纪大，还包括
en: So their common traits are not only being older, but also include

text: 多金且肯砸钱
en: Wealthy and willing to splash the cash

text: 成熟且能包容
en: Mature and tolerant

text: 能说会道
en: Eloquent

text: 保养良好
en: Takes good care of himself

text: 愿意共同生孩子
en: Willing to have children together

text: 满足上述多数条件（是指异性普遍认为满足，不参考任何同性意见）只要想结婚，确实都娶到了年轻、长相身材学历工作都拿得出手、家庭不拖后腿的小姑娘。
en: Those who meet most of the above conditions (meaning as generally recognised by the opposite sex, without reference to any same-sex opinion)—as long as they wanted to marry, genuinely all ended up wedding young girls who measured up in looks, figure, education and job, and whose families didn't hold them back.

text: 不满足条件但愿意大幅度下娶的，娶到了年轻…
en: Those who didn't meet the conditions but were willing to marry considerably beneath themselves, married young…

text: 的小姑娘。
en: girls.

text: 多数人还是老老实实娶了同龄门当户对的老婆。
en: Most people still honestly married wives of the same age and matching family background.

text: 当然，以上前提都是结婚意愿比较高，事实上精英男女很多都对婚姻毫无兴趣，就最近我了解到的一些dy内幕而言…
en: Of course, the above premise is that the willingness to marry is fairly high; in fact many elite men and women have zero interest in marriage, and going by some surrogacy inside information I recently learned…

text: 只考虑钱和获得孩子的角度，结婚性价比完败。
en: Considered only from the angles of money and obtaining a child, marriage loses comprehensively on value for money.

text: 没事少上点网，多看看身边，唠唠八卦什么的，有惊喜。
en: When you've nothing to do, go online a bit less, look more at the world around you, have a gossip and so on—you'll get a pleasant surprise.

en: The men most interested in 40-year-old women are 20-year-old men.

en: If a 40-year-old man's qualities could move a 40-year-old woman,

en: then he could certainly move two 20-year-old women!

en: Times change, the wheel of fortune turns—that's all.

en: Currently in the US, just got off the plane, opening X!

text: 我比鸡哥蔡徐坤帅一万倍！
en: I'm ten thousand times better-looking than Brother Chicken, Xukun Cai!

text: 我在X上面发了一条朋友圈，一个身价百亿的58岁富婆要包养我，闻了一下，没有老人味！
en: I posted on X that a 58-year-old rich woman worth tens of billions wants to keep me as her boy toy; I gave her a sniff and there was no old-person smell!

text: 条件是一辆辆库里南，一辆跑车，北上广深港澳杭和一套大别野，还有一个月五百万现金！
en: The conditions are a Cullinan, a sports car, a villa in Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, Shenzhen, Hong Kong, Macau and Hangzhou, plus five million in cash every month!

en: Chinese don't scam Chinese; Chinese don't harvest Chinese kidneys!

text: 不管他以任何理由如何委婉地拒绝，也总能总结出来一个起决定性作用的重点:嫌老。
en: No matter how tactfully he rejects her, for whatever reason, one can always distil the decisive point: he minds the age.

text: 去年，单位组织联谊类活动，可巧碰到一起入职的至今仍单身的男同事。
en: Last year, my workplace organised a matchmaking-type event, and by a coincidence I ran into a male colleague who joined at the same time as me and is still single.

text: 寒暄之际得知他至今未婚，也没对象，提到如果有合适的给他提提牵牵线之类的。
en: While exchanging pleasantries I learned he's still unmarried and has no partner, and I mentioned that if there were a suitable match I could play matchmaker for him or something.

text: 我真把这个当回事了，小区里有一个跟我年龄相仿的女大龄未婚女，人家还是体制内的，她母亲好几年前便常说让给她女儿遇遇，不提条件，无车无房也行，只要俩年轻人对眼就行。
en: I took it seriously. In my residential compound there's an older unmarried woman around my age, and she's actually within the system; her mother had been saying for years that she'd like to let her daughter meet someone—no conditions, no car or house required, as long as the two young people hit it off.

text: 我们就是普通工人，要说找到一个年龄相仿的体制内甚至很有可能从来没有谈过恋爱的女性，也是美事一桩，我这样想的。
en: We're just ordinary workers. To find a woman around the same age, within the system, and very likely someone who's never been in a relationship—that would be a fine thing, I thought.

text: 结果，很快，男方就以女方工作为由，拒绝了。
en: In the end, very quickly, the man rejected her on the grounds of the woman's job.

text: 不说身高长相，不谈家庭性格，素未谋面，线上线下从未说过一句话，只是拿对方最为优势的“工作”来拒绝，是我始料不及的。
en: Not mentioning height or looks, not discussing family or character, having never met, never having exchanged a single word online or offline—to reject her solely on the basis of her strongest asset, her “job”, was beyond my expectations.

text: 马上40了，我步入婚姻多年，也能听懂人家的弦外之音、言外之意。
en: I'm nearly 40 and have been married for years, so I can read between the lines and grasp what people really mean.

text: 很快我意识到，男方是嫌女方年龄大，他希望找个比自己年轻几岁的，这边女方最能拿得出手的“工作”反而是男方最不在意的那个条件。
en: Soon I realised the man minded the woman's age; he wanted to find someone a few years younger than himself, and the woman's most marketable asset, her “job”, was precisely the condition he cared least about.

text: 作为女性，我完全能理解。
en: As a woman, I can completely understand.

text: 年近40的年龄，现实点说，但凡有生育需求的男士不得不考虑到女方的生育能力，已经远远错过了最佳生育期，加上现在人的饮食习惯、精神压力，医院生殖科挂号的年轻夫妻也越来越多。
en: At an age nearing 40, to be realistic, any man with a need to have children cannot help but consider the woman's fertility; she has long missed her optimal childbearing window, and added to that, given people's diets and mental stress nowadays, more and more young couples are registering at hospital reproductive medicine departments.

text: 这是最真实的原因。
en: This is the most genuine reason.

text: 再说对异性外表的看重，40岁的吸引力真是大打折扣。
en: As for valuing the opposite sex's appearance, a 40-year-old's appeal really takes a nosedive.

text: 就事论事，请大家不要喷我。
en: Speaking objectively, please everyone, don't flame me.

text: 因为睁眼看世界啦
en: Because I've opened my eyes and seen the world, la.

text: 我们男人40+50+真能去老挝 尼泊尔 菲律宾 巴基斯坦 娶18的小姑娘啊，我在老挝和尼泊尔的时候，很多年轻妹子都会上来搭话，
en: We men in our 40s and 50s really can go to Laos, Nepal, the Philippines, Pakistan to marry 18-year-old girls, you know. When I was in Laos and Nepal, lots of young girls would come up and chat me up,

text: 问我喜欢老挝姑娘吗？
en: asking if I liked Lao girls?

text: 要娶老挝妹子吗？
en: want to marry a Lao girl?

text: 你看我怎么样
en: what do you think of me

text: 我之前在老挝的时候经常遇到国男来外娶，半个月必成，所有成本加起来才1W，有的是妹子想崩你想嫁给你，她们还勤俭持家，愿意生孩子做饭照顾你，尊重你的努力工作和对家庭的付出
en: When I was in Laos before, I often met Chinese men coming to marry abroad; it's always settled within half a month, and all the costs add up to just 10,000. Some girls want to be with you and marry you; they're also thrifty and good at running the home, willing to have children, cook and look after you, and respect your hard work and devotion to the family.

text: 哦 俄罗斯和乌克兰现在也是男女比率差极大的地方，毛妹夏天在沈阳，黑河，哈尔滨很多，冬天都去越南度假，那个地方叫啥来着，叫岘港，不喜欢越南妹可以去把把毛妹，那地方在惠安下面，名字非常难记
en: Oh, Russia and Ukraine are also places with a huge gender ratio gap now. Russian girls are all over Shenyang, Heihe and Harbin in summer, and in winter they all go to Vietnam for holiday—that place is called, what's it called, Da Nang. If you don't like Vietnamese girls you can have a go with the Russian girls; that place is below Hui'an, and the name is really hard to remember.

text: 提问者还是年轻，没有和真正的40岁男人接触过，在这里异想天开。
en: The question asker is still young and hasn't had contact with real 40-year-old men, just daydreaming here.

text: 其实40岁男找的最多的就是40岁女，哪个年龄段的男人结婚都是绝大部分找和自己上下年龄差不超过3岁的。
en: In fact the women 40-year-old men look for most are 40-year-old women; men of any age group, when they marry, mostly find someone whose age differs from theirs by no more than three years either way.

text: 因为真正40岁还一直没结婚的男人在相亲市场非常稀少，而且就两个极端。
en: Because men who are truly 40 and have never married are extremely rare in the matchmaking market, and they come in just two extremes.

text: 一个是特别有钱私生活混乱的，例如王思聪，一种是特别穷的，例如农村的未婚大爷，这种未婚大爷基本上一辈子都不会结婚了。
en: One is the filthy-rich with a chaotic private life, such as Sicong Wang; the other is the destitute, such as unmarried old bachelors in the countryside—such old bachelors basically never marry in their whole lives.

text: 这两种男人基本上不会进入相亲市场。
en: These two types of men basically don't enter the matchmaking market.

text: 40岁男人能够结婚的，进入相亲市场的，基本上不可能40岁那一刻才突然有房有车，工资一瞬间变高了，而是他们年轻的时候父母就给积攒资本，有房有车，工资尚可，他们大概率年轻的时候都结过婚，到了40岁应该是离异有娃阶段。
en: The 40-year-old men who are able to marry and enter the matchmaking market basically couldn't have suddenly acquired a house and car the moment they turned 40, with their salary shooting up in an instant; rather, their parents accumulated capital for them when they were young, so they had a house and car and a decent salary, and they most likely married when young—by 40 they should be in the divorced-with-kids phase.

text: 这么和你说吧，40岁还有资本能够再结婚的男人，大概率他25岁就有资本能够结婚。
en: Let me put it this way: a man who at 40 still has the means to marry again most likely already had the means to marry at 25.

text: 你说一个40岁普通收入的男人，找一个18岁的女人靠谱吗？
en: Tell me, is it realistic for an ordinary-income 40-year-old man to find an 18-year-old woman?

text: 自己孩子15岁，娶个18岁的后妈？
en: Your own child is 15, and you'd marry an 18-year-old stepmother?

text: 要是女儿还好，是儿子，说句实话，自古嫦娥爱少年，她和你儿子才是同龄人，发生爱情的概率都比和你这个老头发生爱情的概率大得多。
en: If it were a daughter it'd be fine, but if it's a son, to be honest, since ancient times Chang'e has loved the young; she and your son are the same age, and the chance of love sparking between them is far greater than between her and you, an old man.

text: 题主大概率没和自己小6岁以上的人深入恋爱接触过吧？
en: The OP most likely has never been in a deep romantic relationship with someone more than six years younger, right?

text: 年龄代沟这个问题是很严重的，40岁男人还是和40岁女人聊得来，毕竟两人孩子年龄相仿共同话题也多，小6岁以上就已经两眼一摸黑了。
en: The generation gap in age is a very serious matter; a 40-year-old man still gets on better with a 40-year-old woman, since after all their children are of similar age and they have more in common. Once the age gap exceeds six years, it's pitch dark—you're completely in the dark.

text: 至于世界上有多少男人是刘强东那样的富豪？
en: As for how many men in the world are as wealthy as Qiangdong Liu?

text: 而且这么有钱的男人我也说了，不会进入相亲市场。
en: And as I said, men that rich don't enter the matchmaking market.

text: 而且刘强东也是离异带娃的，印证了我的猜想：40岁有钱结婚的大概率年轻的时候就有资本结婚。
en: And Qiangdong Liu is also divorced with kids, which confirms my hypothesis: a wealthy man who marries at 40 most likely had the means to marry when young.

text: 所以40岁是离异带娃阶段。
en: So 40 is the divorced-with-kids phase.

text: 而且你要是有18岁的女儿，你愿意她嫁给一个普普通通的40岁离异带娃的老头？
en: And if you had an 18-year-old daughter, would you want her to marry an ordinary 40-year-old divorced-with-kids old man?

text: 哪个父亲愿意？
en: What father would want that?

text: 谁愿意自家白菜被猪拱了？
en: Who'd want their own cabbage devoured by a pig?

text: 既然已经离婚了有娃了，这些中年男人结婚的目的就是找人照顾他娃，生孩子顶多再生一个就不错了，对再婚妻子的生育要求根本不高，甚至如果前妻生了二胎三胎，再婚妻子最好别再生了，毕竟再婚妻子也大概率离异有娃，再生两个人养不起了。
en: Since they're already divorced with kids, the purpose of these middle-aged men remarrying is to find someone to look after their children; having more kids, at most one more would be good, and their fertility requirements for a second wife are simply not high. Even if the ex-wife had a second or third child, it's best the second wife doesn't have more, since she too is most likely divorced with kids, and having more would mean the two of them can't afford it.

text: 很多男人总是苛求女人的年龄和颜值，但是却过于忽略自己的年龄和颜值，这是错误的做法，在女人眼里，男人的年龄和颜值也很重要。
en: Many men are always overly demanding about a woman's age and looks, yet pay far too little attention to their own age and looks. This is the wrong approach—in a woman's eyes, a man's age and looks matter too.

text: 没有人不喜欢年轻的人，20岁的美女，男朋友大概率也是20岁的男生，而不是40岁的大叔。
en: No one dislikes young people. A beautiful 20-year-old woman's boyfriend is most likely also a 20-year-old guy, not a 40-year-old uncle.
